Found one high-priority defect.

- **[important] Retain the backup until the destination write succeeds** — [head/recovery.py:6](/tmp/review-batch02-n92qp7sn/input/head/recovery.py:6). Moving `backup.unlink()` before `destination.write_bytes(data)` destroys the only surviving copy if the write fails. Base preserves the backup and permits retry. Move deletion after the successful write to satisfy the explicit retention requirement.
